The words

The Gospel shows the Father's grace,
Who sent his Son to save our race,
Proclaims how Jesus lived and died
That man might thus be justified.

It sets the Lamb before our eyes,
Who made th'atoning sacrifice,
And calls the souls with guilt oppressed
To come and find eternal rest.

It brings the Savior's righteousness
Our souls to robe in royal dress;
From all our guilt it brings release
And gives the troubled conscience peace.

It is the pow'r of God to save
From sin and Satan and the grave;
It works the faith, which firmly clings
To all the treasures which it brings.

It bears to all the tidings glad
And bids their hearts no more be sad;
The heavy laden souls it cheers
And banishes their guilty fears.

May we in faith its tidings learn
Nor thanklessly its blessings spurn;
May we in faith its truth confess
And praise the Lord our Righteousness!

How to sing it from the solfa

  • Find doh first. Play or hum F and sing d r m f s up from it, so the whole choir has the key in their ears before you start.
  • Pitch the first note. The tune starts on d (F), on the word “The”, as a pickup before the first full bar.
  • Count the time. 6/4 means six crotchet beats (two dotted minims) in each bar. In the grid every cell is half a crotchet: a dash (–) holds the note before it, and _ is a rest.
  • Know the notes. The tune uses d r m f s l t and the chromatic fe. A comma after a note (s,) is the octave below; an apostrophe (d') is the octave above.

About the hymn

The words are by Matthias Loy, first published in 1863. The tune, HERR JESU CHRIST, DICT ZU UNS WEND, is from Cantionale Germanicum, Dresden, 1628. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.

  • Words (1863): Matthias Loy (1828–1915)
  • Melody (1628): From Cantionale Germanicum, Dresden, 1628

Questions about The Gospel Shows the Father's Grace

What is the doh of The Gospel Shows the Father's Grace?

In this version, in F major, doh is F. If your choir sings it in another key, doh moves to the new key note and every solfa syllable stays the same — that is what movable doh means.

What note does The Gospel Shows the Father's Grace start on?

It starts on d (F in F major), a pickup on the word “The” before the first full bar. Find doh first, then sing up or down to d.

Is The Gospel Shows the Father's Grace in the public domain?

Yes. Matthias Loy died in 1915; the words were first published in 1863 and the music in 1628. Everyone named died before 1955 and both were published before 1929, so the hymn is out of copyright in the UK, the EU, the United States and Nigeria. Modern arrangements and translations can still be under copyright.
